$comment: Input for test/tally-xml.test.ts, whose golden output is tally-vouchers.v1.xml beside it. One of each voucher type, with figures chosen so every rule is visible: the first invoice is intra-state (CGST+SGST, no IGST), the second is inter-state (IGST alone) and unregistered (no GSTIN), the credit note reverses the first at full value the way migration 0051's columns do, one buyer name carries the ampersand Tally's parser is strictest about, and the two receipts cover a bank reference present and absent. Every money value is written as it comes off a frozen numeric(18,2) snapshot column: two decimals, no symbol, no sign.
